features: All three EAs — Omnicor, Cenith & Golden
One trading account, tied to your licence key
Every update and new release included

eaPlans.ibNote: Requires a trading account under one of our partner IB brokers

eaPlans.name: Any Broker
eaPlans.tagline: The same three machines, on whatever broker you already trust.
features: All three EAs — Omnicor, Cenith & Golden
One trading account, tied to your licence key
Every update and new release included
Cancel any month — no contract, no lock-in

billing.note: Billed monthly, paid in USDT. Stopping is simply not paying the next month — there is nothing to cancel.

capital.standardNote: The strategy was built and tested at a 0.1 minimum lot. On a standard account that needs $10,000 behind it to hold its shape.
capital.centNote: Under $10,000? Use a cent account. Same EAs, same strategy, one-hundredth of the scale — $100 behaves the way $10,000 does.
capital.brokerNote: Your broker must permit grid trading and offer 1:500–1:1000 leverage. Our partner brokers already do.

membershipLadder.note: Manually maintained — see PRD §14.1. slotsLeft must always be true.

membership.name: Exclusive Membership
membership.tagline: Own the engines outright — and never pay a monthly fee again.
features: Every future release included, for life

benefits.v: Every .mq5 file, yours to read, keep and modify.
No monthly fee, ever — including every release the lab ships after you join.
No account lock. Run the machines wherever you trade.
Parameters and set files tuned to your account size and your broker.
New EAs reach you before they reach anyone else.
Members choose which pair the lab builds next.

notIncluded: No profit sharing — what your account makes is yours
No managed accounts — you trade your own, always

onboarding.headline: Running in under 15 minutes

steps.v: USDT. We confirm it and send your setup guide straight away.
With a grid-friendly broker, then send us the account number.
All three files plus your licence key, bound to that account.
Drop each EA on its chart. The guide covers the one server link you add in MetaTrader.

onboarding.note: Fifteen minutes end to end. Longer only if it is your first time installing an EA on a VPS — and we stay with you until it runs.
onboarding.setup: All three run on default settings. No input files to configure, unless you want Golden on its SL/TP strategy.
